item.title: Kansas House studies bill granting unprecedented administrative autonomy to KU, K-State, and WSU
item.description: The Kansas Board of Regents voted unanimously Wednesday to oppose a bill granting the state’s three largest public universities — KU, KSU and WSU — unprecedented autonomy in purchasing, construction, licensing, bidding and ownership of property. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas champions of administrative reform at public universities offer concessions to calm skeptics
item.description: The Republican majority leader of the Kansas House and the governor's chief of staff worked Thursday to resolve objections to a bill designed to make the state’s three largest public universities more financially efficient by removing layers of administrative red tape. item.title: City board recommends Bert Nash repay funding for housing that won’t come to fruition
